purpose: Teach: 神浦/杉村/野坂/荒井/北野/日高/牛尾/広瀬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の神浦先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — take on the research your advisor Professor Kamiura was doing.
lines.style: Clear, measured directive. Light emphasis on the name. Steady gaze. Speaking from authority but not coldly — this is a real responsibility being handed over.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。杉村教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Sugimura's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Quiet resolution — not cheerful, but committed. Slight pause before responding, as if absorbing the weight of what he's been asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の野坂先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — check in with Professor Nozaka on the collaborative research.
lines.style: Same steady authority as before. Concrete instruction. No negotiation in the tone, but not unkind — just clear about what needs doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で荒井助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Arai's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Acknowledging. Quick, efficient. The voice of someone taking mental notes — absorbing each task before moving to the next. Respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の北野先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also reference Professor Kitano's papers in the literature.
lines.style: Continuing the sequence without pause. Same firm kindness. The 'also' lands without heaviness — just another piece that fits into the larger structure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の日高先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll seek guidance from Hidaka, my senior in the lab.
lines.style: Respectful, acknowledging the hierarchy. Soft on the honorific. Still absorbing — the voice of someone building a map in real time, understanding how to navigate this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の牛尾教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — meet with Professor Ushio about the international partnership.
lines.style: Final directive in the sequence. Same measured tone. Lands with finality — this is the last piece, and it matters. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、広瀬事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application through Hirose in the administrative office for research funding.
lines.style: Closing note of commitment. Slightly more detail in this response — he's naming the specific next step. Respectful but grounded. The voice of someone who has understood and is already moving forward.
